reviews.author: Avanthi Gadipudi
reviews.text: I have had the pleasure of knowing Dr. Aishwarya personally, and I can confidently say that she is an exceptional doctor and a truly beautiful human being, inside and out. Her dedication to her patients is unparalleled, always available to offer advice and support whenever needed. Dr. Aishwarya exudes empathy, talent, and transparency in her practice, making her a trusted and invaluable healthcare provider. I wholeheartedly recommend her to anyone seeking compassionate and competent medical care.

reviews.author: Ankitha Manohar
reviews.text: I have known Dr Aishwarya as a compatriot and colleague for the last 5 years. She's a hardworking and dedicated doctor who always has her patient's concerns in mind and cares for them with her heart. I wish her all the best in her new endeavour.

reviews.author: Bharathi Arun
reviews.text: The place of miracles. Giving very positive vibes. Especially mam, the way she cares for the patients is the best thing to have. Her smile while treating the patients will automatically bring positive thoughts. She is also a good human being. Thanks to the god for knowing her. Thankyou for everything.

reviews.author: Krish S
reviews.text:
Special thanks to Aishwarya mam for making the journey to delivery very positive for us with her guidance. She was always available for our queries, literally just a phone call away. Suggested us the most natural ways to be physically and mentally healthy in terms of food, exercises which helped in a normal delivery. She rescheduled her other appointments on the date of delivery for prioritising us and ensured a personal care.

In Accumed speciality clinic we have the latest scanning facilities. Dr. Ashwin Muralidharan was the first to show us the baby image in 3D with colour. Even though we have taken those scans several times outside he was the one who first told us that this was even possible. He was very patient friendly and supportive.

reviews.author: archana sekar
reviews.text:
Thank you Dr.Aishwarya Mam and Dr.Ashwin sir for your timely availability and care during our pregnancy journey. We came to know Aishwarya Mam through social channels and approached her for our pregnancy checkups. Way she has handled the patients are truly extraordinary. She never miss to reply us if we msg her our doubts. We had a normal delivery because of Dr. Aishwarya Mam support and motivation. To have a smooth and positive Pregnancy journey we recommend Dr.Aishwarya Mam as a gynecologist.
- Archana & Dinesh

reviews.author: Niranjana Gayathri
reviews.text: About ASCAS, well maintained and clean place. Staffs are very friendly and respond immediately on all our silly doubts. One place to cover all medical support like doctor consultation,scan and pharmacy. Right from booking appointment till the end of scan or consultation the team is smoothly guiding us without any major delay.  One postive ambiance and best doctors I would personally recommend to go ahead without any second thoughts. Dr. Aishwarya is positive, energetic person irrespective of multiple patience she make sure our individual attention is given 100%. Thanks to  Dr. Aswin for the all the scans to go smooth, detailed and explained each and every process and made sure we are leaving the clinic without any doubts . Kudos to the entire ASCAS team.

reviews.author: Samiksha D
reviews.text: I have just delivered by baby safely despite having high risk pregnancy because of dr Aishwarya only .from the day I found out to the day I delivered,everyone including staff and doctor have always been so patience .special thanks to dr Ashwin also who patiently explained the scans .I would highly recommend dr Aishwarya as my baby and I are safe just because of her.she is skilled and as well as very helpful.

reviews.author: radhika narayanan
reviews.text:
Aishwarya mam is a meaning for determination and dedication.
I am always inspired by her multitalented personality of handling everything smartly .Fan of her determination towards her work . To tell shortly about my fertility journey  ,I had previous history of second trimester miscarriage and i had been to many top gynaecologist in the city for second conception .Nothing worked, many suggested about exoensive surgeries without a proper diagnosis .

Finally i got a chance to meet our god sent angel 😇 .Always grateful for the immense support that you have given us mam

She made a proper diagnosis and also suggested not to go for any expensive surgeries and i got naturally conceived with her proper guidance .

She guided me through my whole pregnancy with correct diagnosis and finally today i gave birth to a beautiful boy baby through normal delivery though i had few complications . Thank you so much for your guidance and support mam ❤️ .

reviews.author: Dr. Yogapriya Vasudevan
reviews.text: Dr. Aishwarya mam is the one of the best hands we have seen. Mam was patient enough in listening and took every single step with utmost care. She is the bundle of positivity, hope and GOD sent angel, bcz of her we are a happy couple today. We are sooo grateful for her guidance. I whole heartedly wish the families in need to have the magical touch of Dr.Aishwarya mam❤

reviews.author: sangeetha santhanam
reviews.text:
Clinic is situated in a good locality ,on road and easily Accessible. Premises is so good and well maintained. I have consulted Dr Aishwarya for my gynec problems. She listens to us patiently and she is always strong and confident about the diagnosis and the treatment. She is  Very simple ,friendly and down to earth. No artificial gimmicks anywhere during the process.
I strongly recommend her for any gynec related problems.
